intro: The Netherlands is a small country with a big trading economy. It has Europe's largest port and is the world's second-largest exporter of food by value.

chapters.title: Gateway to Europe
text: Rotterdam is the largest port in Europe, and goods arriving there travel on by river, rail and road across the continent. Amsterdam's Schiphol is one of Europe's busiest airports.
Big Dutch companies include Philips, Heineken and ASML, which makes the only machines in the world able to print the most advanced computer chips.

chapters.title: Greenhouses and flowers
text: Despite its size, the Netherlands exports more food by value than any country except the United States, thanks to high-tech greenhouses that grow tomatoes, peppers and flowers. Aalsmeer has one of the largest flower auctions in the world.
A huge gas field under Groningen supplied Europe for decades, but drilling caused earthquakes and it was closed in 2024. The Netherlands uses the euro.

keyTerms.meaning: A glass building where plants grow in controlled warmth and light.
